messages:
alex_k: Quick RFC follow-up on air-gapped bootstrap choices — graceful degradation (partial sync + limited feature set) vs require full sync before any activation. Wanted to capture tradeoffs and a proposed two-phase activation model.

maria_s: +1 we need this spelled out. If we allow degraded mode, what surface area is limited? model pulls, evals, telemetry?

jonathan: Proposal: index-first + staged blob fetch. Boot with a minimal manifest + runtime blobs so API responds quickly, then lazy-fetch large model blobs. Pros: better first-response UX. Cons: complexity in cache misses and evaluations returning degraded results.

sam_t: Main worry is attestation. Operators often insist on full cryptographic verification of all artifacts before they consider the node "trusted". Partial installs make audits messy.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created issue #AI-INF-847 tracking 'degraded-bootstrap' feature - added triage label.

alex_k: Thinking: two-phase activation state machine — QUARANTINE (untrusted, read-only ops) -> PARTIAL_ACTIVE (limited inference, no sensitive models) -> FULL_ACTIVE (all models present & verified). Operator explicitly promotes or automatic promotion after verification.

maria_s: For UX we need: (1) CLI flag `--allow-degraded-bootstrap`, (2) console UI showing missing blobs + estimated bytes + last-known signer, (3) audit event when operator accepts risk.

jonathan: Implementation notes: index-first lets us know which blobs are missing up-front. Transport should support resumable chunked fetch and a resume token so long-tail transfers (satcom/air-gap USB) can resume. This avoids re-downloading large blobs.

sam_t: Also require per-blob checksum + manifest hash chain. Activation policy example: require all critical blobs signed; non-critical (e.g., auxiliary eval sets) can be deferred. Need clear definitions of critical vs non-critical.

alex_k: State transitions (pseudo):
```
DOWNLOADING -> QUARANTINE (index validated) -> PARTIAL_ACTIVE (operator opt-in or policy) -> FULL_ACTIVE (all critical blobs verified) -> ROLLBACK (on mismatch)
```

maria_s: Edge-case: certificate rotation mid-partial-deploy. We should either stall rotation until full activation or accept ephemeral certs with explicit operator approval. Add to RFC.

jonathan: Recommend API endpoints: `/bootstrap/status`, `/bootstrap/resume`, `/bootstrap/accept-risk` and console warnings. Also include metrics: missing_blob_count, bytes_remaining, time_estimate_seconds.

sam_t: I'll draft the RFC with test harness scenarios: 1) low bandwidth (10Mbps) resume tests, 2) corrupt-blob rejection and rollback, 3) operator-acceptance flow. Will add audit event examples.

alex_k: Awesome — thanks @sam_t. If you can link the draft here when ready we'll schedule a short async review. :+1:
